content.short: Skrill is a Paysafe-owned digital wallet and money-transfer service for online payments, transfers and crypto.
content.description: Skrill is a long-established digital wallet and money-transfer service, part of the Paysafe group, that lets people pay online, send money internationally and manage funds across borders. Users get a multi-currency wallet, a prepaid card, low-cost international transfers and the ability to pay at millions of online merchants, with a loyalty program rewarding frequent activity. Skrill also offers in-app buying and selling of cryptocurrencies for consumers who want to trade alongside everyday payments. Popular with online shoppers, gamers, traders and people sending remittances, it focuses on fast, global money movement from a single account, competing with newer neobanks and transfer apps on international payments.
